lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn2Co2Ge2S8 (MnCoGeS4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Ge each in tetrahedral S coordination, while Mn adopts octahedral S coordination. Corner-sharing occurs between Co and Ge tetrahedra and between Co and Mn octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
